_comment: Art pipeline rules (docs/ART_PIPELINE.md, §28.1a). Read by the Blender scripts (tools/blender/), the Godot post-import script (scripts/import/lh_post_import.gd), the runtime material hookup (PaletteMaterials) and the model checks in tools/DataValidator. Budgets from §28.1a where the design doc gives them; every other number is a [TWEAK] starting guess.

kit_grid._comment: Modular Georgian kit (§28.1a/§28.3). One wall module = one window bay. storey_height_m matches rendering.json extrusion.level_height_m.

kit._comment: Ceiling for one kit piece (a large cupola is the biggest). Per-piece targets are in docs/ART_PIPELINE.md; what §28.1a budgets is the assembled building (bldg).

bldg._comment: Typical building 1-5k tris (§28.1a). Era variants per §28.1a.

hero._comment: Hero landmark <= 15k tris (§28.1a): Upham arch, the Seal, King Library, Sesquicentennial Chapel, Kumler Chapel, Yager, Goggin, Formal Gardens, Slant Walk.

char._comment: Person figure <= 500 tris with 3-4 LODs (§28.1a). Era clothing sets are separate files (char_student_1960s ...).

prop._comment: Lamp posts, benches, bike racks, signs. Instanced in large numbers.

tree._comment: Trees swap foliage by season (§28.1); instanced in large numbers.

lod._comment: LOD n may have at most max_ratio_to_lod0[n] x the LOD0 triangle count. range_margin_m = hysteresis so LODs don't flicker at the switch distance.

_special_materials_comment: Materials that aren't brand colours. Everything else must use a pal_<branding colour>[_<index>] material so colours swap with branding.json.
